other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir
Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Jammu & Kashmir with active membership at the time of applying
Applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months
Applicant must provide proof of the dependent relationship for sons, daughters, siblings, or self
benefits_summary: Provides a marriage assistance of ₹25,000 per marriage, up to three marriages for the worker or their dependents.
